section.heading: Luxury Accommodations
section.description: Please note all bookings will be accommodated in Eland Chalet (Main unit). Guest from 1 to 6 person can be accommodated in the main Unit, if the group exceeds the amount, automatically the next Chalet Oryx will be booked. If The group dynamic exceeds 10 guest automatically the next Chalet Kudu will be booked which holds another 2 double bed rooms. Elkana can accommodate max 14 guest at once in a group.
